title: Circulaire n° 001/AMF-UMOA/2024: taxonomy of eligible projects for green, social and sustainable bonds (WAEMU regional market)
citation: Circulaire n° 001/AMF-UMOA/2024 (AMF-UMOA), taxonomy of eligible projects for green, social and sustainable bonds
evidence: No official page states the date: amf-umoa.org is a JavaScript shell with no circular text (opened 2026-11-09). The date 2024-02-28 comes from a law-firm note (Lextenso, labase-lextenso.fr), not an official page.
notes: Regional WAEMU text issued by the AMF-UMOA, not a Burkina Faso text, so the Burkina Faso copyright statute (Loi 048-2019/AN art. 10) does not decide its status. Terms not readable on the publisher site, so no records. The taxonomy is also relevant to other WAEMU states; nothing about them is checked here.
status_note: circular text not reached; AMF-UMOA terms not readable as text

title: Loi n° 006-2013/AN portant code de l'environnement du Burkina Faso
citation: Loi n° 006-2013/AN portant code de l'environnement, promulgated by Décret n° 2013-406/PRES
evidence: No official page read. Secondary sources only: UNEP LEAP (leap.unep.org) gives 148 articles and decree 2013-406/PRES of 2013-04-02; a BOAD copy (admin.boad.org, not official) gives a transmittal letter dated 16 April 2013. No in-force sentence found.
notes: Official URL is the Légiburkina home page, named as the legal database by an Ecolex entry; the page did not answer on 2026-11-09 and the operator is not confirmed. Art. 10 of Loi 048-2019/AN excludes official legislative texts from copyright, so an official copy from an official host can be stored once found (BF-ASSEMBLEE-ADOPTED is pass). Date conflict (2 vs 16 April 2013) unresolved. F2 status to confirm.
